nodes.label: Blog Content module README
nodes.rationale: First domain module registered directly in the base repo (epic #536, issues #537-#543). module.ts status is active.

nodes.label: Public routes /news + /blog/{tenantCode}
nodes.rationale: Two coexisting route families (neither retired). /blog/{tenantCode} resolves tenant from path segment (ADR-0009); /news resolves via resolvePublicTenantFromRequest (Host header, ADR-0010). Both are .ts APIRoute (not .astro) so integration tests can invoke handlers directly. Two visibility predicates: listing = visibility='public' strict, detail = public|unlisted. withNewsTenant centralizes module-disabled + route-mode gate with padUnresolvedTenantLatency timing-parity fix.

nodes.label: Content quality checklist gate (Issue #640)
nodes.rationale: evaluateContentQualityChecklistForContent runs server-side before publish/schedule transition (not just client preview). No-op unless full-online R2-only news_portal mode active. Scheduled publishing was restructured from set-based UPDATE to SELECT..FOR UPDATE per-post loop so a blocking rule leaves a post scheduled rather than bypassing the checklist.

nodes.label: ABAC author-own-draft ownership override
nodes.rationale: evaluateContentUpdateAccess expresses 'editor/admin with permission OR (caller==authorTenantUserId AND status!=published)' as OR. Deliberately NOT placed in identity-access evaluateAccess (deny-biased cross-module evaluator, ADR-0004); the ownership ALLOW override is blog_content business logic composed on top — calls evaluateAccess first, falls back to ownership only when the sole deny reason is default_deny. publish/schedule/archive/restore/purge have no ownership override.

nodes.label: Append-only blog revisions (Issue #541)
nodes.rationale: awcms_micro_blog_revisions is append-only (same pattern as awcms_micro_audit_events); restore writes a NEW revision recording restored state, never UPDATE/DELETE. Restore requires explicit blog_content.revisions.restore (no ownership override) + Idempotency-Key. isSignificantContentChange only creates a revision when title/contentJson/contentText change.

nodes.label: Scheduled publishing worker job
nodes.rationale: bun run blog:publish:scheduled — internal worker (cron/systemd timer), not HTTP. publishDueScheduledPosts idempotent by construction; FOR UPDATE guards against two concurrent workers for the same tenant. No external provider call (pure DB transition); mediaPort adapter only reads Postgres, not R2.

nodes.label: Effective public route settings (Issue #564)
nodes.rationale: fetchEffectivePublicRouteSettings merges two existing stores, deliberately not a third. rssEnabled/sitemapEnabled stay in awcms_micro_blog_settings (NOT the new descriptor defaults) to avoid two disconnected sources of truth — a proven correctness bug, not style. legacyTenantRouteEnabled=false returns generic 404 (not redirect) for consistency and to avoid leaking that a tenant is host-reachable. publicBasePath only changes GENERATED URLs, not the physical Astro static route.
